title: AntFabric UI token extension
description: What each token in tokens.json carries under $extensions["com.antfabric"], beside the W3C Design Tokens Format Module's own $type, $value, $description and $deprecated. `pnpm check names` holds tokens.json to this file.

tier.description: semantic: a role any component reads. component: owned by the components in `component`.

component.description: The docs ids of the components a component token belongs to.

visibility.description: Present when the token is left out of the documented set. It still resolves and can be themed.

modes.description: The token's value in each mode, when they differ: { light, dark } for colours and shadows, { web, desktop, mobile } for sizes and type, with an OS key (android) where that OS changes its profile's value.

additionalProperties.description: A value in the W3C Design Tokens format for the token's $type, or a reference in braces.

onlyIn.description: The profiles that have the token, when not all three do.

sameInDark.description: The same in light and dark on purpose.

source.description: Where the value was copied from: a product token, a path in the phone app's theme, a proposal awaiting a decision, or unmapped (this library's own).

mobileSource.description: The phone app's name for it, where it has one.

sourceNote.description: Why the source is what it is.

notes.description: Where a profile's value or use differs from desktop's.

css.description: The string the kits use, where $value cannot say it exactly (a percentage, em, a gradient's angle).

renamedTo.description: On a deprecated token: the path it was renamed to.

since.description: On a deprecated token: the version that renamed it.

cssVar.description: On a primitive: the product's CSS variable.
